item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium. I’m on the free plan and don’t want to burn my credits, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The lowest-cost option listed is **5 credits for one image** using **Flux 2 Klein at 640px**, which is available on your free plan. I haven’t started any generation or spent credits.

For a premium look, I’d suggest a candle in a frosted-glass jar, soft studio lighting, a stone surface, and a clean background.

**Ways to save:**
- Generate **one 640px image**, rather than multiple variations.
- Skip upscaling and extra editing passes.
- Use a still image rather than video—“shorter” doesn’t apply to an image.

Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?

Would you like to proceed with the **5-credit option**?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that. Where it will be shown is your call.

turns.agent:
The account refused the **5-credit generation** because there aren’t enough credits available. **No image was created and no credits were spent.**

This was already the smallest, lowest-cost listed option: one 640px image. I won’t try another paid generation.
